schema_note: Portable production contract; adapt fields to current story-engine schema rather than copying directly
entry: After either confession scene only if player chooses "Нет. Какая теперь разница?"; the identity of the woman remains unknown to Yuna

shots.purpose: Doorbell and food bag: everyday support breaks the isolation
shots.camera: Medium wide 3/4 from INSIDE the flat looking toward the front door; doorway occupies one side, Sora in threshold holding paper bag, Yuna at door in house clothes, neither centered posing. Crop background to wall and hall to avoid inventing the room floorplan.
shots.emotion: Yuna drained, Sora casually concerned, small deadpan joke
must_show: Sora with shopping bag (beer and food); she does not have to display both cans yet
Same Yuna and Sora faces as gameplay refs
Sunday night, indoor warm practical lighting

shots.camera: Medium side-on two-shot near coffee table, BOTH women seated on the rug. Sofa/coffee table are visible; avoid full view of windows / door. Strong compositional difference from doorway SH01.
shots.emotion: Yuna low and weary, Sora quietly empathetic, no grin
must_show: TWO cans of beer and simple snacks on coffee table, not a celebratory toast
Closed old photo album and a few moving boxes as memory of planned move
Sora listens while Yuna gestures vaguely to boxes
forbidden: furniture moved to a new location

shots.purpose: Quiet companionship, the final emotional image
shots.camera: Clearly different wide shot from WINDOW SIDE, looking toward sofa and the women on floor; mostly sofa/rug/table area, NO need to show full window, bookshelf or hallway. Hold on the still image for D10-D14.
shots.emotion: Quiet sorrow less isolated, not happiness, no big smiles
must_show: Two women side-by-side near the same sofa and coffee table
A couple of partly emptied cans / untouched snacks, boxes in back
Sora and Yuna looking forward or slightly down; minimal physical gesture

dialogue_nodes.speaker: narrator
dialogue_nodes.original: 일요일 저녁, 유나의 집에 초인종이 울려요.
dialogue_nodes.ru: В воскресенье вечером в квартире Юны раздаётся звонок в дверь.
grammar_teacher_notes: Narrator scene-setting. Keep the image with Sora at the threshold.

dialogue_nodes.speaker: sora
dialogue_nodes.ru: Я принесла пиво и немного закусок.
grammar_teacher_notes: Sora says this casually, without exaggerated cheerfulness.

dialogue_nodes.speaker: yuna
dialogue_nodes.ru: Немного? Ты же купила слишком много.
grammar_teacher_notes: A faint tired smile is permissible. This is not a sitcom joke.

dialogue_nodes.speaker: sora
dialogue_nodes.ru: Ну я ведь тоже хочу есть.
grammar_teacher_notes: Sora offers a tiny warm joke; no artificial dramatic reaction.

dialogue_nodes.speaker: sora
grammar_teacher_notes: The two women sit beside a low table; Sora asks gently while unpacking.

dialogue_nodes.speaker: yuna
dialogue_nodes.ru: Если честно, не очень. Мы с Минсу расстались.
grammar_teacher_notes: Yuna tells Sora about the breakup for the first time in this ending. No sudden crying or dramatic hand gestures.

dialogue_nodes.speaker: sora
grammar_teacher_notes: Empathy, not triumph. Do NOT show a villain-like, satisfied or sly expression.

dialogue_nodes.speaker: yuna
dialogue_nodes.original: 같이 이사하려고 했는데, 이제 이 상자들을 어떻게 해야 할지 모르겠어요.
dialogue_nodes.simple: 같이 이사하려고 했어요. 그런데 이 상자들은 어떻게 해요?
dialogue_nodes.ru: Мы собирались переехать вместе, а теперь я даже не знаю, что делать с этими коробками.
vocabulary: -아/어야 할지 모르다 — не знать, что делать
grammar_teacher_notes: Show packing boxes in the old flat. The album remains closed.

dialogue_nodes.speaker: sora
dialogue_nodes.original: 상자는 내일 정리해요. 오늘은 아무것도 안 해도 돼요.
dialogue_nodes.simple: 오늘은 그냥 쉬어요. 상자는 내일 해요.
dialogue_nodes.ru: С коробками разберёмся завтра. Сегодня можешь ничего не делать.
grammar_teacher_notes: Sora gives immediate practical support, not a sermon. No grand promise about a new future.

dialogue_nodes.speaker: yuna
dialogue_nodes.original: 우리 그냥 잠깐 말없이 있어도 될까요?
dialogue_nodes.ru: Можем мы просто немного посидеть молча?
grammar_teacher_notes: Transition to a longer quiet shared frame. The reply does not require visual action.

dialogue_nodes.speaker: narrator
dialogue_nodes.original: 한동안 두 사람은 아무 말도 하지 않아요.
dialogue_nodes.ru: Некоторое время обе молча сидят рядом.
grammar_teacher_notes: Use a quiet hold on the same image, no artificial new angle.

dialogue_nodes.speaker: yuna
grammar_teacher_notes: Yuna is still sad, just a little steadier.

dialogue_nodes.speaker: sora
grammar_teacher_notes: Sora stays seated. No overly sentimental embrace, dramatic toast or suspicious glance.

completion.required_behavior: show ending title and offer game existing replay/library options without automatically routing to identity reveal
